region_scene_page.compact: Industrial metal put electronic production and heavy guitars into the same pressure system, making machines sound emotional, violent, or seductive.
region_scene_page.standard: Industrial metal put electronic production and heavy guitars into the same pressure system, making machines sound emotional, violent, or seductive. White Zombie's Thunder Kiss '65, Rob Zombie's Living Dead Girl, Rammstein's Ich will, and Nine Inch Nails' Head Like a Hole give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Industrial metal put electronic production and heavy guitars into the same pressure system, making machines sound emotional, violent, or seductive. Unlike synthpop or house, the machines here are abrasive and guitar-driven rather than purely dance or song-polish tools. White Zombie's Thunder Kiss '65, Rob Zombie's Living Dead Girl, Rammstein's Ich will, and Nine Inch Nails' Head Like a Hole give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
